# AdaptivePhotonicRouter

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A router architecture that adjusts its switching behavior in real-time based on network state and memory-driven policies, without centralized control. Provides low-latency, distributed control for TCC interconnects, avoiding the scalability limits of centralized optical circuit switching.
